comment: Judged on the paper's metric (A-B, r0 = 9.0, T <= 10, tracker). Three in-domain runs (H, V, diagonal) give RMSE/L 0.00738, 0.00737, 0.00764 against bar 0.018. This is the K-sensitive regime, and the errors sit just above the 0.006 predicted_error and well inside the bar. Supports the claim at the separation and time stated.
